name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: A MUTUAL (two-way) non-disclosure agreement where BOTH parties share confidential information with each other, for example while exploring a joint venture, partnership, merger or collaboration.

fields.label: Purpose of sharing information (for example exploring a joint venture)
City whose courts will have jurisdiction

rules.message: The confidentiality period should be between 1 and 25 years.

preamble: This MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT (the "Agreement") is made at {{signing_place}} on {{agreement_date}} (the "Effective Date")
BETWEEN {{party_one}}, having its address at {{party_one_address}} ("Party One", which expression includes its successors and permitted assigns),
AND {{party_two}}, having its address at {{party_two_address}} ("Party Two", which expression includes its successors and permitted assigns).

Party One and Party Two are together called the "Parties" and individually a "Party". A Party that shares Confidential Information is the "Disclosing Party", and a Party that receives it is the "Receiving Party". Each Party may act in either role.

WHEREAS the Parties wish to share confidential information with each other for the following purpose: {{purpose}} (the "Purpose"), and each has agreed to protect the other's information on the terms of this Agreement.
NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:

variants.balanced: "Confidential Information" means information that a Party shares with the other in any form that is marked confidential, or that a reasonable person would understand to be confidential from its nature or the way it is shared. It includes business plans, finances, customer and supplier details, technical data, designs, software and the existence and content of the discussions between the Parties.

Each Party, as Receiving Party, will protect the other's Confidential Information with at least reasonable care, use it only for the Purpose, and not disclose it to anyone except as this Agreement allows.

(a) A Receiving Party may share Confidential Information with its directors, employees and professional advisers who need to know it for the Purpose and who are bound by confidentiality duties at least as strict as this Agreement. It is responsible for any breach by them.
(b) If the law, a court or a government authority requires disclosure, the Receiving Party will, where lawful, give the Disclosing Party prompt written notice and disclose only what is required.

This Agreement does not apply to information that (a) is or becomes public without breach of this Agreement, (b) the Receiving Party already knew without any duty of confidentiality, (c) the Receiving Party develops independently without using the Confidential Information, or (d) the Receiving Party lawfully receives from a third party who is free to share it.

(a) All Confidential Information remains the property of the Disclosing Party. This Agreement gives the Receiving Party no licence or other right in it, except to use it for the Purpose.
(b) Confidential Information is provided as it is, without any warranty of accuracy or completeness, unless the Parties agree otherwise in writing.
(c) This Agreement does not oblige either Party to enter into any further agreement.
A Receiving Party will tell the Disclosing Party promptly in writing if it becomes aware of any unauthorised use or disclosure of the Confidential Information, and will cooperate to limit the harm.

On written request, or when the Purpose ends, each Party will return or delete the other's Confidential Information and confirm this in writing, except for copies it must keep by law or in routine backups, which remain subject to this Agreement.
The obligations in this Agreement continue for {{term_years}} years from the Effective Date, and for trade secrets for as long as they remain trade secrets.
Each Party may seek an injunction or other urgent relief in addition to any other remedy available under law if the other Party breaches this Agreement.

(a) This Agreement is governed by the laws of India.
(b) If a dispute arises, the Parties will first try to settle it through good-faith discussion for 15 days after one Party gives written notice of the dispute.
(c) If it is not settled, the courts at {{jurisdiction_city}} have jurisdiction.

(a) This Agreement is the entire agreement between the Parties about the Confidential Information and replaces earlier discussions on it.
(b) It can be changed only in writing signed by both Parties.
(c) If any part is found unenforceable, the rest continues in force.
(d) Neither Party may transfer its rights or duties under it without the other's written consent.
(e) It may be signed in counterparts, including electronically.

This Agreement will be stamped as required by the stamp law that applies at the place of signing. The stamp duty and related costs will be shared equally by the Parties unless the law requires otherwise.
